decisions.statement: Upkeep dying takes every model account down with upkeep once the last token runs out.
Upkeep says nothing when upkeep dies.
The ruling is made from two stamps upkeep writes onto each page's uncommitted file.
Nothing beyond those stamps is read.
An account below the token life floor is an account upkeep should have renewed and did not.
Eligibility is judged from the usage numbers alone with no regard for their age.
Upkeep stopping freezes the pool at whatever upkeep last read.
Both bounds are worked out from upkeep's own margin and period rather than restated here.
The worst fault found is the fault reported.
The population is the model-account pages there are.
The population is stated on every run.
A page that could not be looked at is a fault.
No model-account there at all is a failure to look rather than a fleet in good health.
A latch is a record that Alan was told.
A latch is held after the notification lands and never before that landing.

definition: a ruling on whether upkeep is still keeping every model account current
